This plan costs 240: 180 minutes of driving plus 60 for the three deferred adults.

- **Deferred:** Bidur farm (2 adults) and Trishuli farm (1 adult) can only reach Tarkeshwar care home. Every road from there toward an evacuation point is damaged, so they are deferred at 20 each (60).
- **Car2:** takes the 3 adults at Shivapuri farm, then moves the 7 children at Gosaikunda school in two trips (4, then 3).
- **Car1:** brings the 4 children from Kalika village, then the 2 elderly at Suryagadhi temple. It then brings the adults from Dhunche school and Galchhi school, each as its own trip.
